description: This source file implements display and device information management for a Linux environment, including classes for udev device monitoring, GPU memory info, HDR properties, and display properties, as well as a main class for connection info and configuration handling.

classes.name: UdevObserverType
classes.description: Monitors udev device events via netlink socket, allowing registration of callbacks for device type changes.

classes.name: GraphicsProperties
classes.description: Provides GPU memory statistics such as total and free RAM by reading specified system files.

classes.name: HDRProperties
classes.description: Retrieves HDR level settings from a specified file and maps string values to HDR enum types.

classes.name: DisplayProperties
classes.description: Manages display connection status, resolution, EDID data, HDCP status, and re-querying display info via DRM.

classes.name: DisplayInfoImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing connection properties and configuration, managing display state, udev monitoring, and notifications.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for display and GPU properties.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: Handles asynchronous event posting and processing for display property changes.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Reads the first line from a file given its filepath.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific udev device type.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a callback registration for a specific udev device type.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming udev netlink messages and triggers callbacks based on device type.

methods.name: TotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns total GPU RAM by reading system files.

methods.name: FreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns free GPU RAM by reading system files.

methods.name: GetHDRLevel
methods.description: Reads HDR level string from file and maps to enum.

methods.name: Connected
methods.description: Checks if the display is connected.

methods.name: RequeryProperties
methods.description: Re-queries display properties, EDID, and HDCP status.
